name: FilterEditor
description: Renders the editor for a column's filter kind (text, number, date, boolean, options, uuid or the column's custom editor).

props.name: label
props.description: The filter's name for accessible labels ("Operating system").

props.name: onChange
props.description: Apply now and stay open (live editors). Undefined removes the filter.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Apply and close (Enter, Apply, Clear). Undefined removes the filter.

props.name: onFlush
props.description:
Register the function that applies a pending typed value: the popover calls it when
it closes by a click outside (Esc discards).

props.name: onLabels
props.description: Labels learnt from a server-loaded option list (for chips).

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.
